address: Geylang Bahru Market & Food Centre, #01-12, 69 Geylang Bahru, 330069, Singapore
bio: This is the place to come for a comforting bowl of soup. The broth is flavourful and sweet; the spinach is crisp and fresh. You can also order stuffed tofu or seafood on top, or add mee tai mak for some starchiness....
